headline: Cal State LA go through the conference without a defeat
dek: Cal State LA finished their conference round without a defeat, then beat Menlo to stretch the run to eighteen matches. They have conceded six goals in all of them, and the two sides to take a point from them did it without scoring.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Fresno Pacific have scored 37 goals and conceded only 27, yet have lost ten of their eighteen matches: a goal difference this healthy has bought them fewer wins than defeats.

wire.line: Cal State San Bernardino have lost three times all season and meet unbeaten Cal State LA next.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Ten matches have passed their date with no result recorded; the latest, and the only one between conference sides, is Cal Poly Pomona's home match with Fresno Pacific.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Cal State East Bay have conceded 52 goals in eighteen matches, more than any other programme in the conference.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Stanislaus State have drawn seven of their eighteen matches, more draws than any other side in the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Cisco Avila has scored twelve of the 40 goals Cal State San Marcos have scored.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Yoel Vazquez has kept five shutouts in goal for Cal State San Marcos.

last_match.line: Cal State San Bernardino lost on this ground in October and have won every match since.

next_match.line: Cal State San Bernardino are the last side to stop Cal State LA winning, here on this ground in October.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
